messages.subject: add extra legend
parts:
Dear all,

I am trying to add an extra legend to add something like this: scale_colour_manual(name = “Neigborhood”, values =c(“blue”,”blue”), labels = c(‘First Order Rook’,’27.4km’)),linetype=c(1,2)) to also specify the difference between the two different linetypes

I know that in order to add a legend there must be some info in the aestetics, and I don’t have it…

Any help on the matter is greatly appreciated!

Ale

here is my code:

ggplot(df, aes(x=Year,y=Km2/1000,color=factor(cluster)))+
geom_line(data=df[df$Neigh=="Rook",],size=1.5,linetype=1)+
geom_line(data=df[df$Neigh=="27.4km",],size=1.5,linetype=2)+
labs(title="Clusters surface area variation",x = "", y = expression(paste("Km"^2*"* 1000")))+
scale_color_manual(name="Clusters",labels=c("High-High","Low-Low"),values=c("red","blue"))

messages.subject: Re: add extra legend
parts:
Why not start with this?

ggplot(df, aes(Year, Km2 / 1000, color = factor(cluster))) +
geom_line(aes(colour = Neigh, linetype = Neight)), size = 1.5)

Hadley

PS. Codelikeproseismucheasiertoreadifyouusespaces;)
